record.paper: Extension of Gyarfas-Sumner conjecture to digraphs

dossier_meta.paper: Extension of Gyarfas-Sumner conjecture to digraphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: Given an oriented forest $F$ and for every integer $k$, $\{\overleftrightarrow{K_2}, K_k, F\}$ is heroic.
dossier_meta.context_text: This conjecture is equivalent to the special case of Conjecture 4.2 where $H = TT_k$ is a transitive tournament, since every tournament on at least $2k$ vertices contains $TT_k$ as an induced subdigraph. It generalises the heroic-set result for $\{\overleftrightarrow{K_2}, K_k, P^+(3)\}$ proved in Theorem 4.3, where $K_k$ denotes the digraph on $k$ vertices with no arc.
